strings.meta.title: pdff — Booleel, jumlel ak sopël PDF, Word, Excel ci anam bu sax
strings.meta.description: Nataalu boole, jumlel, wàññi, xaaj ak aar say PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ak nataal. Du laaj turu bindu, say jumtukaay dañuy farku tekk.
strings.meta.keywords: boole pdf, jumlel pdf, pdf ci word, word ci pdf, jpg ci pdf, pdf ci jpg, wàññi pdf, xaaj pdf, excel ci pdf, jumtukaayu pdf yu sax
strings.footer.text: Amul fay, du laaj turu bindu. Say jumtukaay dañuy farku fi mu nekee rekk.
strings.home.title: Say téere yépp, ci benn jumtukaay.
strings.home.subtitle: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, nataal: boole, jumlel ak sopël ci ay segut.
strings.home.trust: Amul fay, du laaj turu bindu, amul nataalu benn seen.
strings.home.orbitHint: Jël benn nataal, wënal wërgeel bi, bësal biir bi.
strings.home.formatsSubtitle: Yi ngay jëfandikoo ci biir bureau yi, daara yi ak sosiyeté yi.
strings.home.steps[0].title: Wàll
strings.home.steps[0].text: Nëndël say jumtukaay wala nga jël ko ci say telefon.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Tànn
strings.home.steps[1].text: Tënël toppante bi, anam gi mu gën a génn wala xët yi ngay jël.
strings.home.steps[2].title: Yeb
strings.home.steps[2].text: Génnukaay bi dafay yeb boppam, mu nekk ci ay sët.
strings.notice.officeMissingTitle: Anam yi ñuy jëfandikoo ci Word, Excel ak PowerPoint dañoo tuub.
strings.notice.officeMissingText: Yebal LibreOffice (amul fay) ngir doxal leen, te nga tambalikaat pdff. Ci Windows:

strings.workspace.approximate: Ci benn PDF, taxawaay bi dafa am soppi: li génn man na laaj yëngu-yëngu, rawatina bu fekke benn scan la.
strings.workspace.targetEmpty: Yokk benn jumtukaay ngir gis anam yi am.
strings.workspace.targetNone: Jumtukaay yi amuñu benn anam bu ñu bokk.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% amul fay
strings.seo.why[0].text: Amul abonma, amul carte bancaire, amul nataal bu ñuy dugal ci say téere.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Du laaj turu bindu
strings.seo.why[1].text: Amul compte bu ñuy sos: ubbeel xët wi, nëndël say jumtukaay, baña xaar.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Say jumtukaay ñoy say yay
strings.seo.why[2].text: Ñu doxal ko, tey far fi mu nekkee. Duñu denc say téere te duñu denc say xibaar.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Anam yépp
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, nataal, EPUB… ci ordinateër wala telefon.
strings.seo.faqTitle: Laaj yi ñuy gën a laaj
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Waaw. Jumtukaay yépp amul fay, amul nataal te dara du taxaw lëndëm ci ginnaaw abonma. Duñu laaj benn carte bancaire.
strings.seo.faq[1].q: Ndax amna benn compte bu ñuy laaj?
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Déedéet. Du laaj turu bindu, du laaj email: mën nga jëfandikoo jumtukaay yi léegi.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Déedéet. Say jumtukaay dañuy doxal liggéey bi nga laaj rekk, te baña des. Kenn du leen jàng te duñu leen séddoo.
strings.seo.faq[3].q: Ndax mu ngi dox ci telefon?
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Waaw. pdff ngi dox ci navigateuru benn telefon, tablette wala ordinateër (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), te du laaj dara lu ñuy yeb.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, nataal (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML ak yeneen.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Mën nga doxal ba {files} jumtukaay ci benn yoon, téere bi génn man na am ba {pages} xët.
strings.privacy.title: Sutura
strings.privacy.description: Naka la pdff di toppee say jumtukaay: amul compte, amul téere bu ñuy denc, amul pub ak jëndu xibaar.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff am na ngir say téere des sa yays. Lii mooy li xew bu ñuy jëfandikoo.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Say jumtukaay
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Da ñuy yeb ci kaaraange (HTTPS), doxal leen boppam, te far leen fi mu nekkee rekk bu li génn paregee. Jumtukaay yu mag yi dañuy dem ci dencukaay bu néew doole bu am tur bu ni mel, te dañuy far leen bu doxal bi jehee; safara bu bëj gannaaw dafay far li des ci 24 waxtu.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Amul compte, amul xibaar bu ñuy jël
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff du laaj turu bindu, du laaj email ak carte bancaire. Kenn du jàng say téere, du leen xool, du leen séddoo te du leen jëfandikoo ngir jàngal intelligence artificielle.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Limu ñuy dem
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Da ñuy lim visit yi ci sutura te amul cookie (Vercel Web Analytics) ngir xam jumtukaay yi gën a jariñ. Amul pub, amul topp-topp ci biir site yi.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Cookie
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Benn cookie rekk: dafay fàttikou làkk wi nga tànn.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Dencukaay
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Site bi ngi nekk ci Vercel ci serveru Paris; tekki Word, Excel ak PowerPoint Render mooy ko doxal ci Frankfurt. Server yi dañuy jëfandikoo jumtukaay yi ci jamonoo tekki bi rekk.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Jokkoo
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Am nga laaj wala wax? Jokkoo ak nun ci xët liggéey bi:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Boole
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Boole ay jumtukaay (PDF, Word, nataal…) ci benn PDF, ci toppante bi nga tànn.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Boole jumtukaayu PDF ci web bi amul fay (Word, nataal, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Boole PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint ak nataal ci benn PDF, ci toppante bi nga bëgg. Amul fay, du laaj turu bindu, amul nataal, jumtukaay yi dañuy far.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Dugal say bind yépp ci benn jumtukaay: pdff dafay jël PDF te ci itam téereu Word, tableauu Excel, presentsiyoŋ ak nataal, boole leen ci benn PDF bu set bu am signet ci benn jumtukaay.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Yokk benn signet ci benn jumtukaay
strings.tools.convertir.name: Jumlel
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Jumlel benn téere wala nataal ci yeneen anam.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Jumlel PDF ci Word, Word ci PDF, JPG ci PDF — amul fay
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Jumlelukaay bu amul fay: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB ak 40+ anam. Ci web bi, du laaj turu bindu, bu baax.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Benn jumlelukaay ngir anam yépp: Word ci PDF, PDF ci Word, JPG ci PDF, PDF ci JPG, Excel ci PDF, PowerPoint ci PDF, PNG ci JPG, EPUB ci PDF… Nëndël say jumtukaay te pdff di la won anam yi mën a nekk rekk.

strings.tools.convertir.options.dpi.label: Dooley nataal bi (DPI)
strings.tools.convertir.options.quality.label: Baaxu JPG / WebP / AVIF (1-100)
strings.tools.diviser.name: Xaaj
strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Xaaj PDF ci ay jumtukaay: ci xët yi wala xët ci xët.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Xaaj PDF ci web bi amul fay — xët yi mu sell
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Xaaj PDF ci ay jumtukaay: ci xët yi, xët ci xët wala xët N yépp. Amul fay, gaaw te du laaj turu bindu.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Yabal xëtu téereu bu mag bi am solo rekk: pdff dafay xaaaj sa PDF ci xët yi nga tànn te dellosi xët yi ci benn sàmm ZIP.
strings.tools.diviser.options.mode.label: Anam
strings.tools.diviser.options.ranges.label: Xët yi
strings.tools.diviser.options.ranges.help: Xët yu ni mel di nekk benn jumtukaay.
strings.tools.diviser.options.every.label: Xët ci jumtukaay
strings.tools.extraire.name: Jël / far xët
strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Denc wala far xët yu am solo ci PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Jël wala far xët yi nekk ci PDF — amul fay
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Denc xët yi nga soxla rekk ci PDF, wala far yi fi nekkul. Ci web bi, amul fay, du laaj turu bindu, amul nataal.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Xët bu amul dara, benn léeb bu amul solo, benn xët bu am ñaari yoon? Bindal xët yi ngay denc wala far (ci misaal 1-3, 7, 10-end) te nga am PDF bu set ci ay segut.
strings.tools.extraire.options.mode.label: Jëf
strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.label: Xët
strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.help: Misaal 1-3, 5, 8-end. Bayyi mu nekk biir = xët yépp.
strings.tools.organiser.name: Soppi toppante xët yi
strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Soppi toppante xët yi, def ñaar, dem ci ginnaaw.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Soppi toppante xët yu PDF ci web bi — amul fay
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Soppi toppante xët yu PDF, yokk xët wala defalma téere bi yépp ci ginnaaw. Amul fay, ci web bi, du laaj turu bindu.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Xët yi scan nañu leen te toppante bi baaxul? Bindal toppante bi bees (misaal 3, 1, 2, 4-end) wala nga dellosi téere bi yépp ci ginnaaw: pdff mooy def li des.

strings.tools.organiser.options.order.help: Xët yi ñu limul dañuy far.
strings.tools.organiser.options.reverse.label: Dellosi téere bi yépp ci ginnaaw (jëfandikoo wul toppante bi ci kaw)

strings.tools.pivoter.tagline: Wënal xët yépp wala benn tànnéef.
strings.tools.pivoter.seoTitle: Wënal PDF ci web bi amul fay
strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Wënal xët yépp yu PDF wala benn tànnéef, ci 90°, 180° wala 270°. Amul fay, gaaw, du laaj turu bindu.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Scan bu dëggoor wala xët bu gudd? Wënal téere bi yépp wala xët yi nga tànn rekk, te baña lu baax.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoTitle: Yokk limu xët ci PDF — amul fay ci web bi
strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Yokk limu xët ci PDF: tànn fi mu nekk, anam "1 / 10", lim bu njëkk bi ak yatt bi. Amul fay, du laaj turu bindu.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Mu baax ngir benn thèse, benn dossier wala rapport: tànn fi mu nekk, anam bi ak lim bu njëkk bi, te pdff lim say xët bu baax.

strings.tools.compresser.seoTitle: Wàññi PDF ci web bi — wàññi yattu jumtukaay bi amul fay
strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Wàññi PDF ngir yabal ko ci email wala yeb ko ci site bu buur. Ñetti baaxu wàññi, amul fay.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Benn site baña jël sa jumtukaay ndax dafa mag? Wàññi sa PDF te bayi bind bi mu leer: tànn bu amul benn perte, bu ñuy aján wala bu dëgër.

strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Aar PDF ci benn baat bu nemeeku (AES-256) te téye sàmm, koppie wala sopël. Amul fay, du laaj turu bindu.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Benn bu ñuy yabal bulletin wala téereu paj, tëj ko ci benn baat bu dëgër: bu dul noonu, kenn mënul ko ubb.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Far baat bi ci PDF bi nga xam baat bi, ngir ubb, sàmm wala boole ko ci anam bu sax. Amul fay.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Xam nga baat bi, waaye bind ko yoon bu nekk dafa sonal? Far ko benn yoon te baña déjj. pdff du yagg daan benn baat bu ñu xamul.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Bayyi mu nekk biir bu fekke PDF bi am na baat bu jëf rekk.

strings.tools.metadonnees.seoDescription: Soppi tur bi, bindkat bi, li ñuy wax ak baat bi ci PDF, wala far leen yépp. Amul fay, ci web bi, du laaj turu bindu.
strings.tools.metadonnees.intro: Tur bi ñuy won ci onglet bi wala turu bindkat bi day won benn modèle bu yàgg? Baxal xibaaru téere bi, wala far leen bu ñuy séddoo.
